title: Zoning text change for affordable housing at 1160 Pugsley Avenue, Bronx
summary: This application would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 1160 Pugsley Avenue in the Bronx's Unionport neighborhood, requiring affordable units as part of new development. It is linked to a companion zoning map change from R5 to R7A/C2-4 for the same site, together allowing an eight-story mixed-use building with ground-floor commercial space, including a grocery store, and 32 accessory parking spaces.
